general_information.name: UH, SORRY, CAN YOU MEAN LIKE THE NAME ON, ON THE CARD OR THE DOCUMENTS? I’M BLANKING A BIT. I THINK IT STARTS WITH ETHAN, BUT—SORRY, I’M NOT SURE WHAT PART YOU WANT ME TO GIVE FIRST.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s speaking up in meetings or any kind of group thing... I just kind of freeze up. I avoid work socials too, and then there’s the blushing and shaking, which is embarrassing. I turned down a promotion because it would’ve meant presenting more, so that’s been a bit… yeah, that’s the main thing.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to speak up in a meeting without panicking, and honestly I’d like to take the next promotion if it comes up.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a pretty quiet, watchful kid... that’s really the main thing I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was a good student, but I avoided presentations all through school. That part never really got easier.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m single. I don’t really have a significant romantic relationship to give you.
personal_history.future_goals: Honestly, I want to build a career that doesn’t depend on avoiding people.
